oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Ameerikaa himata Iraan xiyyaara waraana Ameerikaa tokko irra miidhaa ga’eera jettee dhiyeessite haaluun beekame. Ajajni giddugaleessa Ameerikaa naannoo handaara Hormuzitti haleellaan akkasii hin raawwatamne jedheera. Xiyyaarotni waraana Ameerikaa hundi naannoo baha giddugaleessatti argaman miidhaa tokko malee nagaan akka jiran ibsameera.

title: 'Will throw keys back to UN': Trump-appointed Board of Peace adviser says Israel blocking efforts
english: A senior official on the US-led Board of Peace has warned that the group will hand its responsibilities back to the United Nations if Israel continues to obstruct the implementation of the Gaza stabilization plan. Although Hamas agreed to the disarmament roadmap, the board states that Israeli officials are blocking key steps, such as training local police and allowing the deployment of international peacekeeping forces. The board is frustrated by the lack of progress and accuses certain members of the Netanyahu government of failing to honor previous commitments made to President Trump.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የሚመራው የሰላም ቦርድ ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን እስራኤል የጋዛን የመረጋጋት እቅድ ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ የምታደርገውን እንቅፋት ካላቆመች ሃላፊነታቸውን ለተባበሩት መንግስታት እንደሚመልሱ አስታወቁ። ሃማስ የትጥቅ መፍቻ ስምምነቱን ቢቀበልም፣ እስራኤል የፖሊስ ሰራዊት ስልጠናን እና የአለም አቀፍ የሰላም አስከባሪ ሃይል እንዲሰማራ በመከልከሏ ስራው መቆሙን ቦርዱ ገልጿል። የቦርዱ አባላት በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ መንግስት ውስጥ ያሉ አንዳንድ አካላት ለፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የገቡትን ቃል በመጣሳቸው ከፍተኛ ብስጭት እንደተሰማቸው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Boordii Nageenyaa kan Ameerikaan durfamu, Israa'el karoora tasgabbii Gaazaaf gufuu ta'uu yoo itti fufte, hojii kana guutummaatti dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniif akka deebisan akeekkachiisan. Hamaas karaa nagaa meeshaa hiikkachuu fudhatee kan jiru yoo ta'u, garuu Israa'el leenjii poolisii fi ergama nageenyaa idil-addunyaa akka hin dhufne dhorkuun ishee hojichi akka hin milkoofne taasiseera. Boordichi, qaamoleen mootummaa Netaaniyaahuu keessa jiran tokko tokko waadaa pirezidaant Traamp waliin galan akka hin eegne himuun, haala jiruuf gadda guddaa ibsaniiru.

title: The TPLF’s Setbacks Do Not Determine Tigray’s Political Future
english: The TPLF's recent losses are mainly the result of internal leadership failures and a disconnect from the people's deep desire for peace after years of war. Internal divisions, forced recruitment tactics, and a misunderstanding of both domestic and geopolitical dynamics weakened their position more than federal military power. The future of Tigray remains uncertain and will depend on how both the TPLF and the federal government reform their approaches to regain public trust.
amharic: የህወሓት የቅርብ ጊዜ ሽንፈቶች በዋናነት የመጡት በአመራር ክፍተት እና ለዓመታት ከዘለቀው ጦርነት በኋላ ህዝቡ ሰላምን ካለው ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት ጋር መራራቅ ነው። የውስጥ ክፍፍል፣ በግዴታ የተፈጸመ ምልመላ እና የፖለቲካ ተለዋዋጭነትን በአግባቡ አለመገንዘብ፣ ከፌዴራል መንግስት ወታደራዊ አቅም በበለጠ መልኩ ድርጅቱን አዳክመውታል። የትግራይ የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ ምን እንደሚሆን ገና ያልተወሰነ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በሁለቱም ወገኖች የሕዝብ አመኔታን ለመመለስ በሚያደርጉት የሪፎርም ሥራ ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው።
oromo: Injifannoon TPLF amma mudate inni gurguddoon dogoggora gaggeessummaa fi fedhii nagaa ummanni waraana waggoota hedduu booda qabu waliin wal-dhabuu irraa kan maddeedha. Rakkoowwan keessoo, dirqamaan loltoota ramaduu, akkasumas haala siyaasaa biyyattii fi naannichaa sirritti hubachuu dhabuun, humna waraana mootummaa federaalaatiin olitti akka isaan laaffatan taasiseera. Fuulduratti Tigraay maal akka taatu murtaa'aa miti; kunis mootummaan federaalaas ta'e TPLF amantii ummataa deeffachuuf jijjiirama akkamii akka godhan irratti kan hundaa'u ta'a.

title: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has publicly labeled Vladimir Putin a killer in response to Donald Trump describing the Russian leader as a friend. Zelensky argued that characterizing Putin in a friendly manner undermines international pressure against him while Russia continues its deadly military strikes across Ukraine. Meanwhile, intense Russian missile and drone attacks have caused numerous casualties and widespread damage to Ukrainian infrastructure.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሩሲያው መሪ ቭላዲሚር ፑቲንን ወዳጄ ብለው በመጥራታቸው ተቃውሟቸውን ገልጸው ፑቲን ገዳይ ናቸው ሲሉ ወቅሰዋል። ዘለንስኪ እንደሚሉት ፑቲንን እንደ ወዳጅ መግለጽ በሩሲያ ላይ የሚደረገውን አለም አቀፍ ጫና የሚያዳክም ነው። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ በዩክሬን ከተሞች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለው የሩሲያ የከባድ መሳሪያ እና የድሮን ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎችን እየገደለ እና መሰረተ ልማቶችን እያወደመ ይገኛል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeleniskin, Donald Traamp gaggeessaa Raashiyaa Vladimir Puutiin 'hiriyoota koo' jechuun waamuun isaanii akka isa aarse ibsan. Zeleniskin akka jedhanitti, Puutiin hiriyaa utuu hin taane ajjeisaa akka ta'an fi isaan waliin haasa'uun dhiibbaa idil-addunyaa irratti godhamu kan hir'isu dha jedhan. Gama biraatiin, haleellaan misaayilaa fi doonii Raashiyaan magaaloottan Yukreen irratti gaggeessaa jirtu lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafachaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa barbadeessaa jira.

title: Deal with EU not dependent on tuition fees agreement, Miliband says
english: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has confirmed that a new trade and cooperation deal with the European Union will proceed regardless of unresolved negotiations over tuition fees for EU students. The agreement includes provisions for reduced food export checks, a youth mobility scheme, and closer energy cooperation. While leaders remain hopeful about reaching a separate understanding on university costs, officials emphasized that these core measures will be implemented as planned.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ኤድ ሚሊባንድ ከአውሮፓ ህብረት ጋር የተደረገው አዲስ የንግድ እና የትብብር ስምምነት፣ በአውሮፓ ህብረት ተማሪዎች የትምህርት ክፍያ ላይ መግባባት ባይደረስም ተግባራዊ እንደሚሆን አረጋግጠዋል። ስምምነቱ የምግብ ምርቶች ወደ ውጭ በሚላኩበት ጊዜ የሚደረጉ ቁጥጥሮችን መቀነስ፣ የወጣቶች የመንቀሳቀስ መርሃ ግብር እና የኢነርጂ ትብብርን ያካትታል። የመንግስት መሪዎች በትምህርት ክፍያ ጉዳይ ላይ ወደፊት መፍትሄ እንደሚገኝ ተስፋ ቢኖራቸውም፣ ዋና ዋናዎቹ የስምምነት ነጥቦች ግን በታቀደው መሰረት እንደሚተገበሩ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri Dhimmi Alaa UK Ed Miliband akka ibsanitti, walii galteen haaraan gamtaa Awurooppaa waliin mallatteeffame barattoota gamtichaa irratti kan xiyyeeffatu kaffaltii barnootaa irratti walii galtee kan hin qabne ta'us kan hojiirra oolu ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru. Walii galteen kun meeshaalee nyaataa erguu irratti qorannoo hir'isuu, sagantaa sochiin dargaggootaa akka salphatu gochuu fi walitti dhufeenya anniisaa cimsuu dabalata. Hogganoonni kaffaltii barnootaa irratti fuuldura furmaata argachuuf abdii kan qaban ta'us, qabxiileen ijoon walii galtee kanaa akka karoorfametti hojiirra akka oolan ibsameera.

title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
english: Climate negotiations at the COP31 summit in Turkey have stalled due to deep disagreements over fossil fuels. A coalition of nations, including several European countries and Panama, is demanding that the final agreement explicitly address the need to move away from oil, gas, and coal. Additionally, African nations are pushing for increased financial support for climate adaptation, while the summit faces the grim reality that global temperature rise goals have already been exceeded.
amharic: በቱርክ በተካሄደው የCOP31 የአየር ንብረት ጉባኤ ላይ በቅሪተ አካል ነዳጆች ዙሪያ በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ድርድሩ መቋጫ አጥቷል። እንደ ፈረንሳይ፣ ፓናማ እና ሌሎች የአውሮፓ ሀገራት ያሉ ቡድኖች የመጨረሻው ስምምነት የነዳጅ እና የድንጋይ ከሰል አጠቃቀምን ለመቀነስ ግልጽ ቁርጠኝነትን እንዲያካትት እየወተወቱ ነው። በሌላ በኩል የአፍሪካ ሀገራት ለአየር ንብረት መላመድ ተጨማሪ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እየጠየቁ ሲሆን፣ ጉባኤው የዓለም ሙቀት መጨመር ግቡን መሳካቱን የይፋ ማድረጉ አሳሳቢ ሁኔታ ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gubaa COP31 kan Turkeetti gaggeeffamaa jiru, dhimma boba'aa lafa keessaa irratti walii galtee dhabuun isaa mariin sun akka dhaabbatu godheera. Biyyoonni Awurooppaa fi Panama dabalatee gartuun tokko, waliigalteen dhumaa fayyadama boba'aa fi carkii (coal) hir'isuuf akka kaayyuu qabaatu jabeessanii gaafachaa jiru. Gamtaan biyyoota Afrikaas deeggarsa maallaqaa gara fuulduraa dabaluuf gaafachaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, waliigalteen kun rakkoo ho'ina lafaa 1.5C ol dabre keessatti akka hin milkoofneef yaaddoo uumeera.

title: Can mediation succeed in a war-torn world? | Episode 1
english: The world is currently facing a record number of armed conflicts, reaching levels not seen since the Second World War. Mediators are finding it increasingly difficult to broker peace due to complex global alliances, proxy wars, and a decline in public trust. This series explores the significant obstacles that modern negotiators face when trying to bring opposing parties to the table.
amharic: ዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃው ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወዲህ ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ሁኔታ ብዙ የጦር ግጭቶች እያስተናገደች ነው። ውስብስብ የሆኑ የኃያላን አገራት አሰላለፎች፣ በተዘዋዋሪ የሚካሄዱ ጦርነቶች እና የሕዝብ አመኔታ መቀነስ የሰላም ድርድርን እጅግ ፈታኝ አድርገውታል። ይህ ዘጋቢ ፕሮግራም ድርድር አቅራቢዎች ጠላቶችን ወደ ሰላም ጠረጴዛ ለማምጣት በዘመናችን የሚገጥሟቸውን ከባድ መሰናክሎች ይመረምራል።
oromo: Addunyaan yeroo ammaa kana kanneen Waraana Addunyaa lammaffaa booda mul'atan irra caalaa lakkoofsaan baay'ataa dhufan walitti bu'iinsa hidhattootaa hedduu keessummeessaa jirti. Walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota gurguddoo, waraanni bakka bu'ootaan gaggeeffamu fi amanamummaan ummataa hir'achuun isaa marii nagaa buusuu baay'ee ulfaataa taasiseera. Sagantaan kun, gareewwan wal diina ta'an marii nagaatiif walitti fiduuf giddudureewwan (mediators) yeroo ammaa kana dhibdee isaan mudatu irratti xiyyeeffata.

title: At least four killed, 35 injured in fire at power station in Iraq’s Basra
english: A major fire at the Hartha power station in Basra, Iraq, has resulted in at least four deaths and 35 injuries. The blaze, which spread to nearby residential homes, caused a complete halt to the plant's 800-megawatt operations. Authorities have managed to extinguish the fire, but the cause of the incident remains under investigation as the country continues to face challenges with aging electrical infrastructure.
amharic: በኢራቅ ባስራ ከተማ በሚገኘው የሃርታ የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ ጣቢያ በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ 35 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። እሳቱ ወደ አቅራቢያው ወደሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች በመዛመቱ የጣቢያው የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ ስራ እንዲቆም ተደርጓል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች እሳቱን መቆጣጠር ቢችሉም፣ የችግሩ መንስኤ እስካሁን አልታወቀም።
oromo: Buufata anniisaa ibsaa Hartha kan magaalaa Basra, Iraaq keessatti ibiddii ga’een namoonni murni afur lubbuun isaanii darbee 35 ammoo miidhamaniiru. Ibidni kun gara manneen jireenyaa ollaa jiranitti babal'achuun hojiin buufata anniisaa kanaa akka dhaabbatu godheera. Hojjettoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa ibidicha to’achuu kan danda’an yoo ta’u, sababni balaa kanaa hamma ammaa hin beekamu.

title: Emergency crews in Ukraine hit by a double-tap strike
english: Russian forces carried out a deadly double-tap attack in Kryvyi Rih, Ukraine, where a second strike targeted emergency responders arriving at the scene of an initial bombing. This tactic resulted in the tragic deaths of a seven-year-old child and a 20-year-old rescue worker. Ukrainian officials highlighted the incident as a deliberate assault on those providing life-saving assistance.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በዩክሬን ክሪቪ ሪህ ከተማ ባደረሱት ድርብ ጥቃት የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞችን ኢላማ አድርገዋል። የመጀመሪያው ጥቃት በተፈጸመበት ቦታ እርዳታ ለመስጠት የደረሱ አዳኞች በሁለተኛው ቦምብ በመመታታቸው የአንድ የሰባት ዓመት ህጻን እና የ20 ዓመት ወጣት የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኛ ህይወት አልፏል። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት ይህ ድርጊት አዳኞችን ሆን ብሎ ለማጥቃት የታቀደ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa magaalaa Kiriivii Rii, Yuukreen keessatti haleellaa yeroo lama walitti aansuun raawwataniin namoota gargaarsaaf dhaqqaban miidhaniiru. Haleellaa jalqabaa booda gargaarsaaf kan dhufan ogeeyyiin fayyaa fi namoonni biraa haleellaa lammaffaan waan rukutamaniif, ijoollee waggaa torba fi ogeessa gargaarsa namoomaa waggaa 20 ta'e tokko galaafatameera. Aangeyyoonni Yuukreen haleellaan kun namoota lubbuu baraaruuf yaalan irratti yaadamee kan raawwatame ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Three US citizens among 4 convicted in Honduras over sex-trafficking case
english: A Honduran court has convicted four individuals, including three Americans, for their involvement in a criminal network that recruited women for sex trafficking. The group, known as the Delta Teams, was linked to the 2022 disappearance of Angie Pena, a student who vanished while on a jet ski. While the defendants were found guilty of criminal association and face up to 10 years in prison, the court acquitted two of the American citizens of direct human trafficking charges due to lack of evidence.
amharic: የሆንዱራስ ፍርድ ቤት ሶስት አሜሪካውያንን ጨምሮ አራት ግለሰቦችን በሴቶች የሰዎች ዝውውር ወንጀል ተሳታፊ በመሆናቸው ጥፋተኛ ብሏቸዋል። እነዚህ ተከሳሾች በ2022 ዓ.ም በካሪቢያን ባህር የጠፋችውን አንጂ ፔና የተባለች ተማሪ ጉዳይ ጋር በተያያዘ የተቋቋመውን 'ዴልታ ቲምስ' የተባለ ህገ-ወጥ ቡድን አባላት ናቸው። ተከሳሾቹ በወንጀል ቡድን ውስጥ በመሳተፍ እስከ 10 ዓመት እስራት ሊቀጡ የሚችሉ ሲሆን፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ግን በቂ ማስረጃ ባለመኖሩ ለሁለቱ አሜሪካውያን የሰዎች ዝውውር ክስ መከላከል መቻላቸውን ገልጿል።
oromo: Mana murtii Honduraas lammiilee Ameerikaa sadii dabalatee namoota afur irratti yakka shiftoo fi dubartoota gurgurachuu (human trafficking) irratti himannaan irratti mirkanaa'eera. Gareen 'Delta Teams' jedhamu kun bara 2022 barattuu Angie Pena jedhamtu erga baddee booda qorannoo irratti godhameen kan qabamanidha. Himatamaan kunneen yakka walta'iinsa shiftootin waggaa 10 takka hidhamuu kan danda'an ta'us, ragaan gahaa waan hin jirreef namoota Ameerikaa lama irraa himannaan gurgurachuu sun kaafameera.

title: Train collides with minibus in Indonesia
english: A passenger train struck a minibus at a railway crossing in North Sumatra, Indonesia, causing the vehicle to catch fire. Three crew members sustained injuries during the incident and required medical attention. The accident resulted in a temporary suspension of rail operations in the area.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ ሰሜናዊ ሱማትራ የባቡር ሀዲድ መሻገሪያ ላይ የባቡር እና የሚኒባስ ተሽከርካሪ ግጭት ተከስቷል። በግጭቱ ምክንያት ሚኒባሱ በእሳት የተያያዘ ሲሆን ሶስት የባቡር ሰራተኞች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሶ ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል። አደጋው በክልሉ የባቡር ትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት ላይ ለጊዜው መስተጓጎል ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Indooneziyaa, Sumaatraa kaabaatti baaburri tokko minibaasii waliin daandii qaxxaamuraa irratti walitti bu’uun balaa ibiddaa qaqqabsiiseera. Balaa kanaan hojjettoonni baaburaa sadan miidhamanii gara hospitaalaatti ergamaniiru. Gochi kun daandii baaburaa irratti tajaajilli akka adda citu godheera.

title: UK, France and China vote against UAE's Lana Nusseibeh at UN
english: UAE diplomat Lana Nusseibeh faced a significant hurdle in her campaign for UN Secretary-General after receiving discouraging votes from the UK, France, and China in a recent straw poll. Although she maintains support from the US and Russia, the opposition from these permanent Security Council members keeps her from reaching the required consensus. Despite the setback and criticism regarding her country's alleged involvement in the conflict in Sudan, Nusseibeh has stated she will continue her candidacy.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች ዲፕሎማት ላና ኑሰይቤህ ለተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ዋና ፀሐፊነት በሚያደርጉት ጥረት፣ በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የድምጽ መስጫ ሂደት ከዩናይትድ ኪንግደም፣ ከፈረንሳይ እና ከቻይና ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። ምንም እንኳን አሜሪካ እና ሩሲያ ድጋፋቸውን ቢሰጧቸውም፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት ቋሚ አባላት ተቃውሞ ስራውን ለማግኘት አስቸጋሪ አድርጎባቸዋል። ኑሰይቤህ በአገራቸው ላይ በሱዳን ጦርነት ተሳትፎ ጋር በተያያዘ የሚነሱ ትችቶች ቢኖሩም፣ እጩነታቸውን እንደማይተው አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Diplomaatin biyya UAE Lana Nusseibeh, aangoo barreessaa olaanaa tokkummaa mootummootaaf godha turan irratti gufuun guddaan isaan mudateera. biyyootni akka UK, Faransaay fi Chaayinaan sagalee isaanii ishee mormuudhaan kennaniiru. Amerikaa fi Raashiyaan ishee deggerus, miseensota dhaabbata gorsaa nageenyaa kana biraa mormiin mudachuu isaatiin carraan ishee shakkiif saaxilameera. Nusseibeh waraana Sudaan keessatti biyyi ishee hirmaatteetti kan jedhu himannaa guddaa darbuus, falmii ishee itti fufuuf murteessiteetti.

title: Pro-Palestine donor James Chambers released, says 'my sacrifice is very small'
english: Spanish authorities have released US media heir James Cox Chambers Jr. on conditional bail while they review a request for his extradition. His release follows the discovery of significant translation errors in the FBI documents submitted by the US to justify his detention. Chambers, who denies the criminal charges against him, stated that his time in jail is minor compared to the ongoing struggle for Palestinian liberation.
amharic: የስፔን ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት የአሜሪካው ሚዲያ ባለቤት የሆኑትን ጄምስ ኮክ ቻምበርስን ከአሜሪካ የቀረበባቸውን የኤክስትራዲሽን ጥያቄ በመመርመር ላይ እንዳሉ በዋስ ለቀቃቸዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህን ውሳኔ ያሳለፈው አሜሪካ በኤፍቢአይ ሰነዶች ላይ ትልቅ የትርጉም ስህተት እንደነበር አምነን ከተቀበለች በኋላ ነው። ቻምበርስ የቀረበባቸውን ክስ ውድቅ ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በእስር ያሳለፉት ጊዜ ለፍልስጤም ነፃነት ከሚደረገው ትግል አንፃር ሲታይ እዚህ ግባ የሚባል አለመሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa Ispeen, dhaaltuu miidiyaa Ameerikaa kan ta'an Jeemsi Koks Chaambers ilaalchisee gaaffii Ameerikaan isaan gadi dhiisisiisuuf dhiyeessite qorachaa osoo jiruun, qabxiiwwan tokko tokkoo guutuudhaan gadi isaan dhiiseera. Gadi dhiifamuun isaanii kan dhufef, ragaalee FBI Ameerikaan dhiyeessite keessatti dogoggorri hiikkaa afaanii guddaan akka ture beekamuu isaa hordofee dha. Chaambers yakka itti dhiyaate kan ganan yoo ta'u, hidhaan isaanii qabsoo bilisummaa Falasxiin waliin yoo madaalamu baay'ee xiqqoo ta'uu dubbataniiru.

title: Morning update
english: Tensions in the Middle East have escalated following renewed violence in Gaza, the West Bank, and Yemen, alongside drone activity near the Strait of Hormuz. Iran expressed a desire for diplomatic solutions with the US even as an American drone was reportedly downed in regional waters. Meanwhile, US officials are addressing the International Criminal Court and regional peace efforts, while Saudi forces continue to intercept incoming Houthi attacks.
amharic: በጋዛ፣ በምዕራብ ባንክ እና በየመን በተቀሰቀሰው አዲስ ግጭት እንዲሁም በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ በተከሰተው የድሮን እንቅስቃሴ ምክንያት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ውጥረት አድጓል። ኢራን ከአሜሪካ ጋር በዲፕሎማሲ ለመነጋገር ፍላጎት እንዳላት ብትገልጽም፣ የአሜሪካ ድሮን ተመትቶ እንደወደቀ ተዘግቧል። በሌላ በኩል የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት በአለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት እና በክልሉ የሰላም ጥረቶች ዙሪያ እየተወያዩ ሲሆን፣ የሳዑዲ ኃይሎችም በሁቲዎች የሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶችን እየከለከሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gidd Galeessa Bahaa keessatti walitti bu'iinsi Gaza, West Bank fi Yaman keessatti uumame akkasumas naannoo Hormuzitti sochii dooniiwwan malee (drones) dabaluun wal dhabdee naannichaa hammaateera. Iran Ameerikaa wajjin mariidhaan furmaata barbaaduu ibsituus, dooniin Ameerikaa tokko naannicha keessatti rukutamee kufuun gabaafameera. Gama biraatiin, aanga'oonni Ameerikaa Manni Murtii Yakkaa Addunyaa fi carraaqqii nagaa naannichaa irratti kan mari'atan yoo ta'u, humnoonni Sa'udii haleellaa Hutiin isaan irratti banan ittisuu itti fufaniiru.

title: Fire at Iraqi power station leaves four dead, 30 injured
english: A major fire at the Hartha power station in southern Iraq resulted in at least four deaths and 30 injuries. Emergency crews managed to contain the blaze, which also damaged nearby residential homes and caused the facility to shut down. Officials are still investigating the cause of the incident and the full scale of the destruction.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ኢራቅ በሚገኘው የሃርታ የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ ጣቢያ በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ 30 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። የእሳት አደጋ መከላከል ቡድኖች እሳቱን መቆጣጠር ቢችሉም፣ አደጋው በአቅራቢያው በሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ጉዳት በማድረሱ የጣቢያው ስራ እንዲቆም ተደርጓል። ባለስልጣናት የእሳቱን መንስኤ እና የደረሰውን አጠቃላይ ጉዳት ለማጣራት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Buufata anniisaa elektirikii Hartha kan kibba Iraaq keessatti argamuutti ibiddi ka'een namoonni afur du'anii 30 immoo madaa'aniiru. Gareen balaa ittisuu ibidda sana to'achuun isaa kan himame yoo ta'u, ibiddichi manneen jireenyaa ollaa jiranis miidhee buufatichi akka dhaabbatu taasiseera. Qaamoleen mootummaa sababa ibidda kanaa fi miidhaa waliigalaa gahuu isaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Seven Gazans wounded, one critically, in Israeli gunfire and airstrikes
english: Seven Palestinians were injured, one critically, following Israeli military operations in Gaza on Saturday. The attacks included shootings at displacement camps in Jabalia and Khan Younis, as well as an airstrike in the southern part of the territory. These incidents add to the high number of casualties reported in the region since the conflict intensified last October.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በጋዛ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ሰባት ፍልስጤማውያን ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን የአንዱ ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ ነው። ጥቃቶቹ በጃባሊያ እና በካን ዩኒስ በሚገኙ ተፈናቃዮች መጠለያዎች ላይ የተፈጸሙ የተኩስ ልውውጦችን እና የአየር ድብደባን ያካትታሉ። እነዚህ ኩነቶች ካለፈው ዓመት ጥቅምት ወር ጀምሮ በክልሉ በግጭቱ ምክንያት ህይወታቸውን ያጡ እና ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን ሰዎች ቁጥር ከፍ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe weerara waraana Israa'el gaanfa Gaazaatti gaggeessineen namoonni Falasxiin torba miidhaniiru; isaan keessaa tokko haalli isaa cimaadha. Miidhaan kun kan ga'e bakkeewwan buqqaatonni keessa jiraatan Jabaliyaa fi Khaan Yuunisitti dhukaasaa fi haleellaa qilleensaan kan raawwatamedha. Haleellaan kun walitti bu'iinsa ji'a Onkoloolessa darbe kaasee biyyattii keessatti adeemaa jiruun namoota miidhaman baay'ina isaa irra kan dabaluudha.

title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler
english: A French court has sentenced three police officers to prison for the 2020 beating of music producer Michel Zecler in his studio. The officers were found guilty of using excessive force and lying in a police report, which was disproven by CCTV footage. The court also identified a racial motive in the attack, leading to stricter sentences and a permanent ban from serving in the police force.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ፍርድ ቤት እ.ኤ.አ በ2020 የሙዚቃ አዘጋጁን ሚሼል ዘክለር በስቱዲዮው ውስጥ በመደብደባቸው ሶስት የፖሊስ መኮንኖች ላይ እስራት ፈርዶባቸዋል። መኮንኖቹ ከመጠን ያለፈ ጥቃት በመፈጸማቸው እና በሲሲቲቪ ካሜራ በተቀረጸው ማስረጃ የተረጋገጠ የውሸት ሪፖርት በማቅረባቸው ጥፋተኛ ሆነው ተገኝተዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ጥቃቱ በዘረኝነት ላይ የተመሰረተ መሆኑን በማረጋገጡ፣ ተከሳሾቹ ከባድ ቅጣት የተጣለባቸው ሲሆን ከፖሊስነት ስራቸውም ለዘላለም ተባረዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii Faransaayitti poolisoonni sadan bara 2020 oomisha muuziqaa Mishel Zeikler jedhamu istudiyoo isaa keessatti reebanii miidhuun isaaniif adabbii hidhaa irratti murameera. Poolisoonni kunneen humna darbe fayyadamuu fi gabaasa sobaa barreessuu isaaniitiin yakkaamanii kan argaman yoo ta'u, gochi isaanii qabxiin kaameeraa CCTV irratti dhugoomera. Mana murtichaa miidhaan kun jibba sanyummaarratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu waan mirkaneesseef, adabbiin cimaan irratti kan murame yoo ta'u, irraa deebi'anii poolisii ta'uu akka hin dandeenye dhorkamaniiru.

title: In a year of AI solving maths problems, Anthropic may have just solved the biggest
english: A mathematician working with Anthropic has claimed to have used the company's Claude AI to develop a proof for the 170-year-old Riemann hypothesis. This complex mathematical problem, which focuses on the order of prime numbers, is considered one of the most significant challenges in the field. While the massive 250,000-line proof is currently being reviewed by experts, its potential verification would mark a major milestone in both mathematics and artificial intelligence.
amharic: ከአንትሮፒክ ኩባንያ ጋር የሚሰራ የሂሳብ ሊቅ፣ የኩባንያውን ክላውድ (Claude) የተሰኘ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ በመጠቀም የ170 ዓመት ዕድሜ ያለውን የሪማን መላምት (Riemann hypothesis) መፍትሄ ማግኘቱን አስታውቋል። ይህ የቁጥር ስርዓትን በተለይም የዋና ቁጥሮችን ቅደም ተከተል የሚያጠናው ውስብስብ የሂሳብ ችግር፣ በዘርፉ ትልቅ ግኝት ተደርጎ ይታያል። ምንም እንኳን የ250,000 መስመር ያህል ርዝመት ያለው ይህ መፍትሄ አሁን በባለሙያዎች እየተጣራ ቢሆንም፣ ከተረጋገጠ ግን በሂሳብ እና በቴክኖሎጂ ታሪክ ውስጥ ትልቅ ለውጥ የሚያመጣ ይሆናል።
oromo: Hayyuun barnoota herregaa tokko kan dhaabbata Anthropic waliin hojjatu, of-koollee AI (Claude) fayyadamuun furmaata yaada sakatta’iinsa Riemann (Riemann hypothesis) kan waggaa 170 lakkoofsise argachuu isaa beeksiseera. Rakkoon herregaa kun kan xiyyeeffatu tartiiba lakkoofsoota bu’uuraa irratti yoo ta’u, sadarkaa idil-addunyaatti qormaata guddaa keessaa tokko dha. Furmaanni inni dhiyeesse kun qajeeltoo 250,000 kan of keessatti qabatu yoo ta’u, ammaaf ogeeyyiin kan ilaala jiran; mirkanaa’uu isaa irraa kaasees hiika guddaa kan qabu ta’a.

title: Can Africa’s new credit rating agency change how the continent is assessed?
english: The African Union has launched the Africa Credit Rating Agency to provide independent and localized financial assessments for the continent's governments and businesses. This initiative aims to address concerns that global agencies often misjudge African economic risks, which has historically led to higher borrowing costs. By using local data, the agency hopes to improve transparency and fairness, though it must prove its credibility to international investors to be effective.
amharic: የአፍሪካ ህብረት ለአፍሪካ መንግስታት እና ኩባንያዎች ገለልተኛ የብድር ደረጃ መመዘኛ ለመስጠት የአፍሪካ ክሬዲት ሬቲንግ ኤጀንሲን በይፋ አቋቁሟል። ይህ ተቋም ዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት የአፍሪካን ኢኮኖሚ አቅም በትክክል ሳይገመግሙ በመቅረታቸው ለሚፈጠረው ከፍተኛ የወለድ ጫና መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ ያለመ ነው። ኤጀንሲው የአካባቢውን መረጃ በመጠቀም ግልጽነትን ለማረጋገጥ ቢሞክርም፣ ተዓማኒነቱን ለማረጋገጥ ከዓለም አቀፍ ባለሀብቶች እምነት ማግኘት ይጠበቅበታል።
oromo: Gamtaan Afrikaa mootummootaafi dhaabbilee Afrikaaf madaallii dinagdee ofdanda'aa ta'e kennuuf 'Africa Credit Rating Agency' jedhamu hundeesseera. Ejansichi kan hundaa'eef, dhaabbileen madaallii idil-addunyaa diinagdee Afrikaa sirriitti hubachuu dhabuun isaanii biyyoota Afrikaa irratti baasii liqii ulfaataa waan geessisuufi. Ejansichi odeeffannoo naannichaa fayyadamuun iftoominaafi madaallii sirrii ta'e fiduuf kan yaalu yoo ta'u, milkaa'ina isaaf amanamummaa gabaa idil-addunyaa argachuun dirqama ta'a.

title: Denmark expels Russian diplomat over alleged plot to kill Ukrainian rapper
english: Denmark has ordered the expulsion of a Russian defense official following allegations that Russian intelligence orchestrated a plot to assassinate a Ukrainian rapper at a Copenhagen concert. Danish authorities arrested three individuals after discovering weapons in a vehicle near the venue, linking the plan to a banned local street gang. In response to this unprecedented aggressive act, the government is also considering restricting Russian access to Schengen visas.
amharic: ዴንማርክ በኮፐንሃገን ኮንሰርት ላይ የዩክሬን ራፐርን ለመግደል በሩሲያ የስለላ ድርጅት ተጠንስሷል የተባለውን ሴራ ተከትሎ የሩሲያን የመከላከያ አታሼ ከሀገር እንዲወጡ አዝዛለች። የዴንማርክ ባለስልጣናት በኮንሰርቱ አካባቢ በተደረገ ፍተሻ የጦር መሳሪያ የያዙ ሶስት ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉ ሲሆን፣ ሴራውም በሀገሪቱ ታግዶ ከነበረ ወንጀለኛ ቡድን ጋር ግንኙነት እንዳለው ገልጸዋል። ይህንን ያልተለመደ የጥቃት ሙከራ ተከትሎ መንግስት በሩሲያውያን ላይ ተጨማሪ የቪዛ ገደቦችን ለመጣል እያሰበ ነው።
oromo: Deenmaark qindeessituu basaastota Raashiyaa tokko, sirbaarratti raapparaa Yukreenii tokko ajjeesuuf karoora baafatamee ture himachuun biyyattiirraa ariitee jirti. Qorattoonni nageenyaa Deenmaark konkolaataa iddoo sirbichaa biratti qabameen meeshaa waraanaa argachuun namoota sadii to'annoo jala oolchaniiru; karoora kana keessattis garee yakkaarraa dhorkame tokkotu hirmaachuu himame. title: Can Mauricio Pochettino save Man United from Premier League relegation?
english: Mauricio Pochettino is set to lead Manchester United for the first time during a high-stakes match against Liverpool. The club is currently struggling in the Premier League relegation zone, a situation that marks a historic decline for the once-dominant team. Despite the team's ongoing challenges and lack of success since 2013, experts believe Pochettino is capable of stabilizing the club and avoiding a disastrous relegation.
amharic: ሞሪሲዮ ፖቼቲኖ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድን ከሊቨርፑል ጋር በሚያደርጉት ጨዋታ ይመራሉ:: ክለቡ በአሁኑ ወቅት በፕሪሚየር ሊጉ ከወራጅ ቀጠና ውስጥ በመገኘቱ ለታላቅ ክለቡ አሳፋሪ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል:: ምንም እንኳን ከ2013 ወዲህ ብዙ ተግዳሮቶች ቢገጥሟቸውም፣ አሰልጣኙ ቡድኑን ከሊጉ ከመውረድ ይታደጉታል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል::
oromo: Mauricio Pochettino yeroo jalqabaaf Manchester United tapha Liverpool wajjin taasisaniin hoogganuuf qophaa'eera. Gareen kun ammaa ammaa sadarkaa gadi bu'aa ta'e irra kan jiru yoo ta'u, kunis seenaa garee kanaaf haala baay'ee yaaddessaa dha. Gareen kun bara 2013 booda milkaa'ina dhabus, hoggantoonni fi qorattoonni Pochettino garee kana gadi bu'iinsa irraa akka oolchu abdii qabu.

title: Iran war live: Saudi-led coalition downs Houthi missiles
english: The Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted three ballistic missiles launched by Houthi rebels toward Riyadh. This follows recent Houthi threats against critical Saudi infrastructure and ports, which were made after the coalition conducted airstrikes in Yemen. Emergency alerts were briefly issued in the Saudi capital as tensions between the two sides continue to escalate.
amharic: በሳዑዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት በሁቲ አማፂዎች ወደ ሪያድ የተተኮሱ ሶስት ባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን መትቶ መጣል ችሏል። ይህ የሆነው ጥምረቱ በየመን ጥቃት ካደረሰ በኋላ ሁቲዎች በሳዑዲ መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ማስፈራሪያ ከሰጡበት ማግስት ነው። በሪያድ ለተወሰነ ጊዜ የድንገተኛ አደጋ ማስጠንቀቂያዎች የታወጁ ሲሆን በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው ውጥረትም እየጨመረ መጥቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii durfamu lolaa fi xiyyaaraa kanaan dursee rokketoota houthii irraa dhukaafaman sadii qilleensa irratti caccabseera. Kunis kan ta'e erga koo'liishiniin sun Yemen keessatti haleellaa raawwatee booda, houthiinni buufataalee fi iddoo hojii Saudii irratti dhaadannoo yeroo dhageessisanitti. Magaalaa guddoo Riyadh keessatti ergaa akeekkachiisaa yeroo gabaabaaf kennamee ture.

title: Overturned boat carrying mourners to funeral kills at least four in Nigeria
english: A boat carrying a large group of mourners to a funeral in southern Nigeria's Bayelsa State capsized on Friday due to a mechanical failure, resulting in the deaths of at least four people, including two children. While 24 passengers were rescued, local residents suggest the vessel was significantly overcrowded, potentially carrying hundreds of people. Authorities have taken the boat's manager into custody while continuing search efforts for any remaining victims.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ናይጄሪያ ባይልሳ ግዛት የቀብር ሥነ ሥርዓት ላይ ለመሳተፍ ሲጓዙ የነበሩ ሰዎች የጫነች ጀልባ በሜካኒካል ችግር ምክንያት ተገልብጣ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በአደጋው ህይወታቸው ካለፈው መካከል ሁለት ህጻናት የሚገኙበት ሲሆን፣ 24 ሰዎች በህይወት መትረፋቸው ተገልጿል። ባለሥልጣናት የጀልባዋን አስተዳዳሪ በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉ ሲሆን፣ ሌሎች የጠፉ ሰዎችን የመፈለግ ስራ አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Naannoo Bayelsa kan kibba Naayijeeriyaatti namoota gara sirna awwaalaatti imalaa turan fe'attee kan turte dooniin tokko rakkoo teeknikaatiin gombifamtee, namoonni afur du'aniiru. Namoota du'an keessaa lama ijoollee yoo ta'an, namoonni 24 immoo lubbuun oolaniiru. Abbaan taayitaa doonichaas to'annaa jala kan oole yoo ta'u, barbaacha namoota badee jiru itti fufuun ibsameera.

title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
english: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has finalized a new agreement with the EU that relaxes food export checks, establishes a youth mobility scheme for thousands of young people, and links emissions trading. The UK government expects this deal to generate up to £17 billion annually for the economy, though opposition leaders have criticized it as a compromise on national sovereignty. Following this progress, the administration plans to continue negotiations to further strengthen ties with the European Union.
amharic: ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ከአውሮፓ ህብረት ጋር የምግብ ንግድ ቁጥጥርን የሚያቃልል፣ ለወጣቶች የመስሪያና የመማሪያ እድል የሚፈጥር እና የልቀት ንግድን የሚያስተባብር አዲስ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። የብሪታንያ መንግስት ይህ ስምምነት በዓመት እስከ 17 ቢሊዮን ፓውንድ ለሀገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚ እንደሚያስገኝ የሚገምት ቢሆንም፣ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ መሪዎች ግን የሀገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነት አሳልፎ የሰጠ ነው በማለት ተችተውታል። ይህ ስኬት እንደተጠበቀ ሆኖ፣ የብሪታንያ መንግስት ከህብረቱ ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ይበልጥ ለማጠናከር ተጨማሪ ድርድሮችን ለማድረግ አቅዷል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeeraa Andy Burnham gamtaa Awurooppaa waliin waligaltee haaraa kanneen akka daldala nyaataa salphisuu, dargaggootaaf carraa hojii fi barnootaa uumuu fi daldala emishinii irratti kan xiyyeeffatu mallatteessaniiru. Mootummaan Breetaan waligalteen kun waggaatti hamma paawundii biliyoona 17 diinagdee biyyattii guddinaaf akka gumaachu kan amanatu yoo ta'u, mormitoonni garuu waligaltee kana aangoo biyyaa gadi jedhanii fudhachuu jechuun komataniiru. Bu'aa kana booda, mootummaan UK gamtaa Awurooppaa waliin hariiroo isaanii caalaatti cimsuuf mariiwwan gara fuulduraatti gaggeessuuf karoorfatee jira.

title: Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations
english: French authorities have launched a formal investigation into actor Gérard Depardieu and author Michel Houellebecq following accusations of sexual assault during the 2018 filming of the movie Thalasso. An unnamed actress claims the two men forced her to engage in non-consensual sexual acts that were not part of the script. The film's director is also under scrutiny for allegedly recording the encounter, though he denies witnessing any signs of distress.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት በፈረንጆቹ 2018 'ታላሶ' በተሰኘው ፊልም ቀረጻ ወቅት በፈጸሙት የወሲብ ጥቃት ክስ ተዋናይ ጄራርድ ዲፓርዲዩ እና ደራሲ ሚሼል ሁልቤክ ላይ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ስማቸው ያልተጠቀሰች ተዋናይት ሁለቱም ግለሰቦች በፊልሙ ስክሪፕት ውስጥ ያልተካተቱ አስገድዶ የመድፈር ድርጊቶችን እንደፈጸሙባት ተናግራለች። የፊልሙ ዳይሬክተር ድርጊቱን በካሜራ ቀርጸዋል ተብለው ቢከሰሱም፣ በወቅቱ ምንም አይነት የተቃውሞ ምልክት እንዳልታዘቡ በመግለጽ ክሱን አስተባብለዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Faransaay, gartuun aktara Jeeraard Diipaardiyuu fi barreessaa Miishel Huulbeek jedhaman, bara 2018 yeroo fiilmii 'Thaalaasoo' hojjetamaa turetti gocha saalaa dirqisiisuun raawwataniiru jedhamanii qorannoo keessa galaniiru. Akkaataa himannaa ishee, aktariin maqaan ishee hin ibsamne tokko dhiironni kun lamaan dirqisiisanii walqunnamtii saalaa raawwachuu ishee fi kunis seenaa fiilmichaa keessatti kan hin jirre ta'uu ibsiteetti. Qindeessaan fiilmichaa kun gocha kana viidiyoon qabaniiru jedhamanii kan shakkaman yoo ta'u, isaan garuu yeroo sanatti rakkoon tokkollee akka hin mudanne dubbachuun himannaa kana haalaniiru.

title: Anthropic shares fall after blockbuster opening as wider tech sell-off continues
english: Anthropic’s stock price declined shortly after a strong market debut, settling back toward its initial offering value. This drop is part of a broader sell-off in the technology sector that has significantly impacted major U.S. stock indexes. Investors are increasingly cautious about the high costs of artificial intelligence investments and whether these massive expenditures will generate long-term profits.
amharic: የአንትሮፒክ (Anthropic) የአክሲዮን ዋጋ በገበያ ላይ በአስደናቂ ሁኔታ ከተጀመረ በኋላ በፍጥነት ማሽቆልቆል ጀምሯል። ይህ መቀነስ በቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፍ ላይ እየታየ ካለው አጠቃላይ የዋጋ ውድቀት ጋር የተያያዘ ሲሆን ይህም በዋና ዋና የአሜሪካ የአክሲዮን ገበያዎች ላይ ተፅዕኖ አሳድሯል። ባለሀብቶች በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ላይ እየፈሰሰ ባለው ከፍተኛ ካፒታል እና ይህ ኢንቨስትመንት የወደፊት ትርፋማነት ላይ ጥርጣሬ በማሳየታቸው ገበያው ተረጋግቶ ለመታየት እየተቸገረ ነው።
oromo: Gatiin aksiyoona dhaabbata Anthropic erga gabaa irratti sadarkaa gaariin jalqabee booda ariitiin gadi bu'eera. Gadi bu'uun kun guddina gabaa teeknoolojii waliigalaa kan biyyoota Gamtoomanii (US) irratti dhiibbaa geessise wajjin wal qabata. Investeronni baasii guddaa teeknoolojii ofiin of-guddistu (AI) irratti taasifamuufi bu'aan isaa gara fuulduraatti maal akka fakkaatu irratti shakkiin isaanitti dhaga'amaa jira.

title: Russia complains of ‘new Iron Curtain’ as Estonia shuts its borders
english: Estonia has announced a temporary closure of its road border crossings with Russia starting in December, citing security concerns and the need to prevent sabotage. Russian officials have criticized this decision, labeling it a modern 'Iron Curtain' and threatening to take retaliatory diplomatic measures. The Estonian government claims the move is essential to stop illegal influence operations and prevent the circumvention of sanctions.
amharic: ኢስቶኒያ ከሩሲያ ጋር ያላትን የመሬት ድንበር መተላለፊያዎች ከታህሳስ ወር ጀምሮ ለጊዜው እንደምትዘጋ አስታውቃለች። አገሪቱ ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደችው የደህንነት ስጋቶችን ለመከላከል እና በግዛቷ ላይ ሊፈጸሙ የሚችሉ የጥፋት ድርጊቶችን ለማስቆም ነው። የሩሲያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ይህንን ውሳኔ በመቃወም አዲስ 'የብረት መጋረጃ' ተብሎ የሚገለጽ ፀረ-ሩሲያ አካሄድ ነው ሲል የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ አጸፋዊ እርምጃዎችን እንደሚወስድ አስጠንቅቋል።
oromo: Itooniyaan sababa nageenyaafi gareewwan biyya keessaa miidhuu danda'an ittisuuf, daangaa lafaan Ruusiyaa waliin qabdu kan gosa daandiiwwan adda addaa ji'a Muddee irraa eegalee yeroof cufuuf murteessiteetti. Mootummaan Ruusiyaa murtee kana balaaleffachuun, tarkaanfiin kun 'komaa sibiilaa' haaraa ijaaruudha jechuun, humni isaa immoo tarkaanfii deebii kan fudhatu ta'uu akeekkachiiseera. Itooniyaan gamtaan, tarkaanfichi kan fudhatame hojiin sabontummaa fi seeraan ala darbuu ittisuuf akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: Israeli drone attacks kill seven Palestinians in central Gaza
english: Israeli drone strikes in central Gaza have resulted in the deaths of at least seven Palestinians, despite an active ceasefire agreement. These attacks hit multiple refugee camps and residential areas, causing widespread fear among the local population who are struggling with limited medical resources. Ongoing military operations and building demolitions continue to disrupt lives across the region.
amharic: በጋዛ ማዕከላዊ ክፍል በእስራኤል ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላኖች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሰባት ፍልስጤማውያን ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት በሥራ ላይ ባለበት ወቅት ሲሆን፣ በስደተኞች መጠለያ ካምፖች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ነበር። ይህ ሁኔታ በህዝቡ ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ፍርሃትን የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ የህክምና ቁሳቁስ እጥረት ባለበት አካባቢ ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሰዎች አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Giddu galeessa Gaazaatti haleellaa xiyyaara nama malee (drone) Israa’el raawwatteetin namoonni Falasxiin sagal ta’an lubbuun darbaniiru. Haleellaan kun walii galtee tasgabii waraanaa cabsee kan raawwatame yoo ta’u, buufataaleen baqattootaa irratti xiyyeeffateera. Haleellaan kun ummata keessa soda guddaa kan uume yoo ta’u, hospitaalonni qorichaa fi humna namaa dhabuun namoota miidhaman wal’aanuuf rakkachaa jiru.

title: Nepali cricket fans in Qatar want to see their team competing with the best
english: Thousands of Nepali expatriates in Qatar gathered at the West End International Cricket Stadium to support their national cricket team during a match against India A. The passionate fans, who traveled from across the country to watch their team, expressed pride in Nepal's growing presence on the global cricket stage. This event highlighted the strong connection between the Nepali diaspora and their home country's sporting progress.
amharic: በቀጠር የሚኖሩ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የኔፓል ዜጎች ለብሔራዊ የክሪኬት ቡድናቸው ድጋፍ ለመስጠት በዶሃ በሚገኘው የክሪኬት ስታዲየም ተገኝተዋል። የኔፓል ቡድን ከህንድ 'ኤ' ቡድን ጋር ባደረገው ጨዋታ ወቅት ደጋፊዎቹ በከፍተኛ ወኔ ቡድናቸውን ሲያበረታቱ ታይተዋል። ይህ ክስተት በውጭ አገር የሚኖሩ የኔፓል ዜጎች ለሀገራቸው ስፖርታዊ እድገት ያላቸውን ትልቅ ፍቅር እና ትስስር ያሳያል።
oromo: Qataar keessa kan jiraatan lammiileen Neephaal kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman, garee kirikeetii biyya isaanii deggaruuf buufata istaadiyeemii kirikeetii Dohaatti walga'aniiru. Gareen Neephaal garee Hindii 'A' wajjin tapha isaa gaggeessaa utuu jiru, deggartoonni kun gammachuu fi onnee guddaadhaan garee isaanii faarfachaa turan. Taateen kun lammiileen biyya alaatti jiraatan, guddina ispoortii biyya isaanii fi jaalala isaan biyya isaaniif qaban kan calaqqisiisu dha.

title: Palestinian anti-Hamas groups accused of role in Israel Gaza operation
english: Local Palestinian militias allegedly backed by Israel are playing an increasing role in military operations within the Gaza Strip. Witnesses reported these armed groups intimidated civilians and forced them to evacuate their homes shortly before an Israeli military offensive took place in the Nuseirat and Bureij camps. This development has sparked significant concern regarding the future of Gaza’s security and the growing coordination between these militias and Israeli forces.
amharic: በእስራኤል ድጋፍ እንደሚደረግላቸው የሚነገርላቸው የፍልስጤም ታጣቂ ቡድኖች በጋዛ ሰርጥ በሚካሄዱ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ላይ ያላቸው ተሳትፎ እየጨመረ መምጣቱ ተሰምቷል። እነዚህ ታጣቂዎች በኑሲራት እና በቡሬጅ የስደተኞች ካምፖች አቅራቢያ በእስራኤል ጦር ከመደረጉ በፊት ሰላማዊ ሰዎችን ሲያስፈራሩ እና ቤታቸውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ሲገደዱ እንደነበር ተገልጿል። ይህ ሁኔታ በጋዛ የጸጥታ መዋቅር ላይ እና በእነዚህ ታጣቂዎችና በእስራኤል ኃይሎች መካከል ስላለው ግንኙነት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: gareen hidhattoota Falasxiin kan Israa'el gargaartu jedhaman, qindoomina Israa'el waliin ta'uun hojii waraanaa Gaza keessatti raawwatan daran dabalaa jiraachuu gabaasameera. Gareen kunneen duula waraana Israa'el kan naannoo buufata baqattootaa Nuseirat fi Bureijitti hin gaggeeffamin dura, ummata nagaa sodaachisuu fi mana isaanii akka gadhiisan dirqisiisuu isaanii ragaan ni mul'isa. Haalli kun gara fuulduraatti nageenya Gaza fi hariiroo garee kanaa fi humnoota Israa'el gidduu jiru irratti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Indian man sentenced to 19 years in US Sikh separatist assassination plot
english: A 55-year-old Indian national, Nikhil Gupta, has been sentenced to over 19 years in a US prison for his role in a murder-for-hire scheme targeting a Sikh separatist living in New York. Gupta admitted to conspiring with an Indian government official to hire an undercover officer to assassinate activist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun. Following the completion of his prison sentence, Gupta will face deportation back to India.
amharic: ኒኪል ጉፕታ የተባለ የህንድ ዜጋ በኒውዮርክ በሚኖር የሲክ መገንጠል አቀንቃኝ ላይ የግድያ ሴራ በማቀነባበሩ በአሜሪካ ፍርድ ቤት ከ19 ዓመት በላይ እስራት ተፈረደበት። ጉፕታ ከአንድ የህንድ መንግስት ባለስልጣን ጋር በመሆን የሲክ አክቲቪስቱን ጉርፓትዋንት ሲንግ ፓኑንን ለመግደል በድብቅ የተላከን መኮንን ቀጣሪ መሆኑን አምኗል። እስራቱን ከጨረሰ በኋላም ወደ ህንድ እንዲባረር ይደረጋል።
oromo: Lammiin Indiyaa Nikhil Gupta jedhamu, Niiwuyorkitti kan jiraatu fi kan adda ba'uu barbaadu hogganaa Siikii tokko ajjeesuuf shiruu isaa irraa kan ka'e, mana hidhaa Ameerikaa keessatti waggaa 19 ol itti murteeffameera. Gupta hogganticha ajjeesuuf nama dhoksaan hojjetu qacaruuf aangessaa mootummaa Indiyaa tokko waliin shiruu isaa fudhateera. Hidhaa isaa erga xumuree boodas gara Indiyaatti kan deebi'u ta'a.

title: US right-wing voices attack Islam online after a study projects global Muslim majority by 2035
english: A recent Pew Research Center study projecting that Muslims could become the world's largest religious group by 2035 has sparked significant backlash from American right-wing figures. Despite the report noting that the Muslim population in the US will remain a small minority, critics are using the data to promote anti-immigration rhetoric and express fears about national identity. Several prominent conservative commentators and politicians have called for urgent action to preserve what they describe as America's Christian heritage.
amharic: የፒው ምርምር ማዕከል እስልምና በ2035 በዓለም ላይ ትልቁ ሃይማኖት ሊሆን እንደሚችል ያወጣው ትንበያ በአሜሪካ የቀኝ ዘመም ፖለቲከኞች እና ተንታኞች ዘንድ ተቃውሞን አስነስቷል። ጥናቱ በአሜሪካ የሚኖሩ ሙስሊሞች ቁጥር አነስተኛ ሆኖ እንደሚቀጥል ቢጠቁምም፣ አንዳንድ አካላት ይህንን መረጃ በመጠቀም ስደትን የሚቃወም ንግግሮችን እያራመዱ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ወገኖች የአሜሪካን የክርስትና እምነት መሰረት ለመጠበቅ ሲሉ ጠንካራ እርምጃዎች እንደሚያስፈልጉ በመግለጽ ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው።
oromo: Qorannoon 'Pew Research Center' baase, bara 2035tti Islaamummaan amantii addunyaa irratti hordoftoota hedduu qabu ta'uu danda'a jedhee tilmaamuun isaa, amantoota mirga qabiyyee (right-wing) Amerikaa biratti mormii guddaa kaaseera. Gabaasichi baay'inni Muslimoota Amerikaa keessatti xiqqoo ta'ee akka itti fufu ibsuus, namoonni tokko tokko ragaa kana fayyadamuun falmii godaantota mormuufi sodaa eenyummaa biyyoolessaa ibsachaa jiru. Namoonni bebbeekamoo kunneen, bu'uura amantii Kiristiyaanaa Amerikaa eeguuf tarkaanfiin hatattamaa fudhatamuu qaba jechuun yaaddoo isaanii ibsachaa jiru.

title: Trump envoys met Qatari officials in Berlin to discuss US-Iran mediation, report says
english: Representatives for Donald Trump, specifically Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, held discussions with Qatari officials in Berlin to explore potential mediation between the United States and Iran. This meeting coincided with a diplomatic visit by the Emir of Qatar to Germany, where he emphasized the necessity of lowering regional tensions. Both parties are focused on utilizing diplomatic channels to improve security and stability throughout the Middle East.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ ተወካዮች የሆኑት ስቲቭ ዊትኮፍ እና ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ስለሚደረግ ሽምግልና ለመወያየት በበርሊን ከኳታር ባለስልጣናት ጋር ተገናኝተዋል። ይህ ስብሰባ የተካሄደው የኳታሩ አሚር በጀርመን ጉብኝት ባደረጉበት ወቅት ሲሆን፣ በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት ለመቀነስ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶች አስፈላጊ መሆናቸውን አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል። ሁለቱ ወገኖች በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ አካባቢ ሰላምን እና መረጋጋትን ለማስፈን በሚቻልባቸው መንገዶች ላይ ተወያይተዋል።
oromo: Bakka buutonni Donald Trump, Steve Witkoff fi Jared Kushner, gidduu Amerikaa fi Iraanitti marii araaraa geggeessuuf jedhamee, Berlinitti hoggantoota Qatar wajjin wal arganiiru. Walgahichi kan geggeeffame yeroo Amiirri Qatar Jarmanitti daawwannaa taasisaniifi, mootummaan Qataris naannichatti waraana tasgabeessuuf carraaqqii dippilomaasii barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsee ture. Gareewwan kunneenis naannichatti nageenyaa fi tasgabbii buusuuf dhimmoota dippilomaasii irratti xiyyeeffatanii mari'ataniiru.
